finding_1.title: orphan-adoption.md has no terminal-status guard before re-adoption
finding_1.occurrence: 2nd (1st was single FIX-FB-WEEKEND-DEDUP-GATE row, noted in conversation only, not escalated per single-observation policy; this tick surfaced 9 MORE at once via task_list_held(kind=orphan-signal, owner_agent=dev-team), all traced to the head-decoupled QA-drain design's 'never release outer_claim on success, rely on TTL lapse' pattern (main.md jump:qa-drain-headdecoupled, line ~851 comment) racing a server-side reaper that converts still-live-but-past-some-liveness-window claims into orphan-signal entries even though the owning session (this one) was never actually dead.
finding_1.evidence: 10/10 orphan-signal rows probed this tick pointed to tasks already DONE or DONE_VERIFIED (4 on live board, 6 already cold-archived to docs/data/orch/archive/2026-08.json). orphan-adoption.md's literal pseudocode (docs/agents/dev-team/flow/orphan-adoption.md lines 11-111) has NO check of the underlying task's current board/archive status before claiming + tree-hygiene-reverting + board-flipping + resume-spawning — blindly following it as written would have re-dispatched 10 duplicate zone-agent spawns on already-finished work.
finding_1.manual_mitigation_applied_this_tick: Router manually cross-checked all 10 original_task_id values against live task_board (all 9 flat+active_sprints+closed_sprints lanes) + cold archive/2026-08.json before deciding not to follow the sub-flow's claim/spawn steps; instead did stale-steal task_claim(task_id=<original_task_id>, task_kind=sprint-task) + immediate task_release on all 10 to clear them from task_list_held, with NO board-flip and NO agent spawn.
finding_1.recommended_fix: Add a terminal-status pre-check to orphan-adoption.md's loop (before the N_MAX gate or immediately after): resolve original_task_id against the same widened multi-lane query already used in main.md's WF-1 BLOCKED-task check (Step 0b, in_progress+active_sprints+done+done_verified+ready), PLUS the cold archive file. If status is already in a terminal set (DONE, DONE_VERIFIED, or absent from live board but present in cold archive as terminal) -> stale-steal + release both locks (no board-flip, no spawn), log skip, continue to next signal — do not fall through to tree-hygiene/spawn.

finding_2.title: orphan-signal release calls in orphan-adoption.md are dead code — ownership mismatch always no-ops
finding_2.evidence: task_release(task_id='orphan-signal:'+original_task_id, owner_client_session=$SESSION) returned {ok:true, released:0} on all 10 attempts this tick (verified live, not theorized) — the orphan-signal lock's owner_client_session is null (owned by 'server-reaper' at the session level, not any specific client session), so no dev-team session's owner_client_session can ever match it. This affects BOTH call sites in orphan-adoption.md: the happy-path release (line 94-98, after successful board-flip+spawn) and the git_sha-invalid dead-end release (line 69-74) — both are unreachable no-ops as written. Practical impact is bounded (the lock self-clears via its own 7200s TTL regardless), but during the TTL window a re-probed orphan-signal could still be a source of confusion/duplicate-adoption-attempt if finding_1's terminal-check isn't also applied on every re-probe.
finding_2.recommended_fix: Either (a) accept this as an intentional TTL-only self-clear design and remove the misleading release calls from the spec (dead code cleanup), or (b) if explicit early-clear is wanted, investigate whether the task tool exposes an admin/agent-level release path that doesn't require exact owner_client_session match on a null-session lock.

no_action_taken: No board rows modified, no agents spawned, no orphan-signal work adopted this tick — all 10 were confirmed pre-existing-terminal and cleared from task_list_held only.
